name: MultiGateway application icon
source: Original artwork generated with the built-in imagegen tool
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final application icon for MultiGateway, a desktop app that unifies multiple AI account gateways. Create one original polished standalone application icon, square 1:1 composition, no text. Design a clean deep midnight-blue rounded-square tile with a bold white geometric gateway symbol centered inside. The symbol should suggest several routes joining one gateway and have a subtle M-like silhouette: two simple rounded portal arches connected by a short central routing bridge, strong balanced geometry, generous negative space, consistent thick strokes, at most three large readable elements. One restrained cyan-blue accent at the convergence point. The tile occupies about 90 percent of the canvas with even transparent padding outside its rounded corners. Premium modern developer tool identity, mostly flat vector-like shapes, crisp edges, high contrast, very gentle tonal variation in the blue tile only. Must remain recognizable as a tiny Windows taskbar icon at 16 to 32 px. Not a mockup: a single centered production icon with no surrounding desktop, no captions, no additional variants. Avoid all third-party logos and any resemblance to WorkBuddy, no mascot, no robot face, no sparkles, no globe, no circuit board, no tiny nodes, no fine decorative lines, no photorealism, no 3D extrusion, no heavy shadow, no watermark. Transparent background outside the app tile.
